implementation: Interpreter observation remains at the actual ARM9 instruction boundary.
JIT observation is emitted only for an existing ARM9 block immediately before ARM_Dispatch.
A64 compiled ARM and Thumb blocks call the semantic monitor at mapped target PCs.
The debug-only monitor gate is read atomically and register state is restored around the callback.

acceptance.reason: A live EU ASMP Castle Garden run must still show equal semantic update periods, normal animation/physics/audio behavior and no timing regression.
